_meta.name: compose-sem-invariance-ladder
_meta.description: The measurement-invariance ladder as ONE compose sweep: a zip over two axes, step [configural, metric, scalar] and eq ["", "loadings", "loadings,intercepts"], expands one multi-group MAT_SEM request (the three-factor CFA of brand_survey.pulse across its two waves) into three slots labelled by step. group_equal reads the eq value as one comma-separated string ("" = configural, nothing held equal), so a scalar sweep axis can carry it. Each slot is a joint lavaan fit; dof rises step by step as loadings, then intercepts, are held equal across waves. Compare chi2, dof, cfi and rmsea slot to slot: a small chi2 rise per degree of freedom gained supports the stricter step. Pulse computes no chi-square difference test. The scalar slot frees the latent means of wave2 (marker units; wave1 stays 0) and recovers the fixture's planted shift: value down about 0.24, service up about 0.525, quality near 0.

params.model:
quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3
value =~ v1 + v2 + v3
service =~ s1 + s2 + s3
